messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Metering alert: token-count variance detected between eu-west and us-east (>18% divergence) for the last 12m. Several customer overage flags queued. Investigate.
amy-oncall: on it, paging billing-eng and eng infra. any immediate customer P0s? @support-lead?
support-lead: got 3 tickets flagged as overage emails sent. I'll pause outbound notifications if we confirm false positives. holding on customer comms until we know cause.
sylvia: looking at the aggregator streams now. quick check: influx in consumer-lag for metering-emitter-2 around 2026-03-17T02:03:00Z. pulling logs.
raj: consumer lag + partition reassignment noise seen. kafka-controller shows partition 14 underreplicated during that window. suspect emitter backlog -> delayed emits -> window boundary misalignment.
amy-oncall: raj, can you confirm which service produced the delayed writes? billing-eng, FYI this could cause delayed counts and then a burst that triggers overages downstream.
raj: grep from broker logs:
```
[2026-03-17T02:02:58Z] partition=14 leader=broker-3 ISR=[2,3] out-of-sync
[2026-03-17T02:03:10Z] reassign partition 14 -> broker-4
[2026-03-17T02:03:40Z] metering-emitter-2 consumer lag=48k msgs
```
raj: looks like emitter had a window flush after lag resolved, causing a big token batch to be emitted to the aggregator. aggregator treats those writes as current-window counts, so counts spike in us-east vs eu-west which wasn't affected.
billing-eng: confirming — our replay dedupe is by event timestamp, but the aggregator windowing is using arrival time. That mismatch is creating the apparent divergence. we're seeing overage flags because arrival-time spikes pushed customers over thresholds for that billing interval.
support-lead: pausing outbound overage notifications now (:white_check_mark:). hunting for affected customers to message once mitigated.
amy-oncall: mitigation plan:
- pause overage notifications (done)
- apply temporary window-tolerant mode on aggregator (tweak config to use event_time if available) — sylvia / billing-eng to coordinate
- start backfill that reassigns late batches to their event windows
- run a customer-safe reconciliation to clear false positives and rollback flags
who owns the config flip?
sylvia: I can flip aggregator to event_time-fallback mode (hot config) but it will slightly change revenue calc until backfill completes. will coordinate with billing-eng for safety.
billing-eng: I will run a scoped backfill for affected windows (approx 02:00-02:10 UTC). ETA 20m for dry-run, 1h for full backfill. will flag any customers with real overages separately.
amy-oncall: assign actions:
- sylvia: toggle event_time-fallback now and monitor
- raj: keep consumer lag monitoring and prevent further reassigns if possible
- billing-eng: dry-run backfill, post snapshot of reconciled counts
- support-lead: prepare customer comms template explaining false-positive overages and rollback plan
please update status in thread.
raj: continuing monitor. consumer lag settled after reassignment, currently stable. putting a short read-only block on partition reassigns for the next 30m.
sylvia: flipping aggregator to event_time-fallback -> true. rolling config 3 pods. watch logs:
```
2026-03-17T02:07:12Z aggregator[pod-7] INFO using event_time fallback for windowing
```
sylvia: initial metrics look good, eu-west/us-east divergence dropping to ~2% in the new windows.
billing-eng: dry-run backfill completed. produced reconciliation delta file: s3://redwood-metering/recon/deltas/6791234567-dryrun.csv. sample diffs show most spikes attributed to 5 emitter batches. scheduling full backfill now. ETA for full run 55m.
support-lead: pull of affected customer list from dry-run: 42 accounts flagged; preparing template. will hold outgoing comms until we confirm full backfill success.
amy-oncall: great. temporary measures look successful. after backfill completes:
- run reconciliation to clear overage flags for false positives
- produce customer email with apology + summary + rollback confirmation
- owner for postmortem: billing-eng
Any objections?
billing-eng: no objections, will own postmortem. root cause: kafka partition reassign + arrival-time windowing mismatch; action items include emitter retry smoothing, aggregator windowing resiliency, and signal to prefer event_time for billing.
support-lead: will issue customer comms after full backfill and final reconciliation. set expectation: will reach out to customers by EOD with update.
amy-oncall: thanks team. keeping pager open until backfill completes. will update thread on completion. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and tagged as sev-2. Pager open.
